list.name: chassis_id
list.label: Chassis
list.query: SELECT chassis_id::text AS __value, chassis_id::text AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT chassis_id FROM experiments ORDER BY chassis_id) c

list.name: channel_idx
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT channel_idx::text AS __value, channel_idx::text AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT channel_idx FROM experiments WHERE chassis_id = ${chassis_id} ORDER BY channel_idx) c

list.name: experiment_id
list.label: Experiment
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, id AS __text FROM experiments WHERE chassis_id = ${chassis_id} AND channel_idx = ${channel_idx} ORDER BY created_at DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM experiments WHERE id = '${experiment_id}'
SELECT schedule_id || ' @ ' || left(schedule_git_sha, 8) AS schedule FROM experiments WHERE id = '${experiment_id}'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cycle_index) + 1, 0) AS cycles_completed FROM experiment_steps WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' AND state = 'completed'
SELECT time AS "time", voltage_v AS value, 'cycle ' || cycle_index AS metric FROM telemetry WHERE chassis_id = ${chassis_id} AND channel_idx = ${channel_idx} AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT min(time) AS "time", max(temperature_c) AS "peak_c", 'channel' AS metric FROM telemetry WHERE chassis_id = ${chassis_id} AND channel_idx = ${channel_idx} AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY cycle_index ORDER BY 1

SELECT cycle_index, step_index, step_name, state, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at))::int AS duration_s FROM experiment_steps WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' ORDER BY cycle_index, step_index
SELECT computed_at AS "time", capacity_ah AS value, 'capacity_ah' AS metric FROM cycle_features WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' ORDER BY cycle_index
SELECT computed_at AS "time", coulombic_eff AS value, 'CE' AS metric FROM cycle_features WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' AND coulombic_eff IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cycle_index
SELECT computed_at AS "time", r0_ohm AS value, 'r0_ohm' AS metric FROM cycle_features WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' AND r0_ohm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cycle_index

SELECT cycle_index, jsonb_array_elements(dq_dv_peaks)->>'voltage_v' AS voltage_v, jsonb_array_elements(dq_dv_peaks)->>'dq_dv' AS dq_dv, jsonb_array_elements(dq_dv_peaks)->>'prominence' AS prominence FROM cycle_features WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' ORDER BY cycle_index DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: dQ/dV peak voltage shift vs Cycle
panels.description: Top 3 most prominent dQ/dV peaks per cycle, plotted by peak voltage. The Severson signature: peaks shift and shrink as the cell ages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT computed_at AS "time", voltage_v AS value, 'peak_' || rn AS metric FROM (SELECT computed_at, cycle_index, (peak->>'voltage_v')::float AS voltage_v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cycle_index ORDER BY (peak->>'prominence')::float DESC) AS rn FROM cycle_features, jsonb_array_elements(dq_dv_peaks) AS peak WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' AND dq_dv_peaks IS NOT NULL) ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY cycle_index, rn

panels.title: SOH vs Cycle
panels.description: State of Health: capacity_ah normalized to the first cycle's capacity. A healthy cell drifts down from 1.0; end-of-life is conventionally 0.8.

targets.rawSql: SELECT computed_at AS "time", capacity_ah / FIRST_VALUE(capacity_ah) OVER (PARTITION BY experiment_id ORDER BY cycle_index) AS value, 'SOH' AS metric FROM cycle_features WHERE experiment_id = '${experiment_id}' AND capacity_ah IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cycle_index
